items.title: US envoys arrive in Ukraine for talks after meeting Putin in Russia
items.description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv on Sunday, having "discussed substantive plans for next steps" with Putin on Saturday, according to the White House.

items.title: US and Iran trade retaliatory attacks on ships as conflict flares
items.description: The US says it hit three Iranian oil tankers, while Iran says it targeted three US-linked ships.

items.title: TV presenter among 12 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
items.description: Sarah Khalifa is best known for her TV programme Mission Impossible which dealt with crime issues.

items.title: Volcano eruption leaves 150,000 passengers stranded in Indonesia
items.description: More than 150,000 airline passengers are stranded after ash was detected in airspace near Jakarta following the eruptions.

items.title: Watch: Moment 64-year-old Nepali woman is found alive in mud-buried home
items.description: Chandika Shrestha was airlifted to hospital after spending more than 10 days in her partially buried house.

items.title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
items.description: The Prince of Wales will represent the King at the funeral of Harald V in Oslo next week.

items.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
items.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

items.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
items.description: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.

items.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
items.description: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.

items.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
items.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

items.title: Nepal rescuers try to reach dozens trapped in tunnel after two found alive
items.description: More than 1,300 people have died and thousands are missing, but rescuers' hopes have risen after finding survivors in a tunnel.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
items.description: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.
